svg.title: FACEBLUR head-model training pipeline
svg.desc: A top-down flowchart: clips are sampled into frames, draft-labelled, corrected in Yolo_Label, split by clip, verified for leakage, trained into best.pt, evaluated per domain against held-aside clips, then shipped as head.pt. An iteration loop returns from evaluation to frame sampling to label the misses.

g.text: Hold ≥1 whole clip per domain aside
Draft .txt so you correct, not draw
Add every missed head (~90% of work)
